testcases.title: GEO-66-TC001 — Perception topics and sentiment filters are displayed
steps: Given an authenticated Editor navigates to the category perception page
When the page finishes loading and the perception area is visible
Then "AI Perception Summary" heading is visible, "Top Concepts Associated with Your Brand" heading is visible, and sentiment filter buttons (All, Positive, Mixed, Negative) are displayed

testcases.title: GEO-66-TC002 — AI Citation Sources section is visible with stacked legend bar and domain table
steps: Given the Editor is on the category page
When the Editor scrolls to the AI Citation Sources section
Then "AI Citation Sources" heading is visible, the stacked legend bar is displayed, and the domain table has at least one row with a favorability badge

testcases.title: GEO-66-TC003 — Domain row click opens AI Citation Source Details drawer
steps: Given the AI Citation Sources table contains at least one domain row
When the Editor clicks a domain row
Then a right-side drawer titled "AI Citation Source Details" opens with Citation Signals (Missed Visibility, Lost to Competitors, Sentiment Issues, Citations by AI Model) and a Cited URLs list

testcases.title: GEO-66-TC004 — Citation Signals shows four diagnostic cards with AI model breakdown
steps: Given the AI Citation Source Details drawer is open
When the drawer renders the Citation Signals and Citations by AI Model sections
Then four diagnostic cards (Missed Visibility, Lost to Competitors, Sentiment Issues, Citations by AI Model) are visible and each AI model row (Gemini, Claude, Perplexity) shows its citation count

testcases.title: GEO-66-TC005 — Cited URLs list shows URL references in the detail drawer
steps: Given the AI Citation Source Details drawer is open
When the Editor scrolls to the Cited URLs section in the drawer
Then the Cited URLs section is visible and contains at least one URL item with title and AI model icons

testcases.title: GEO-66-TC006 — Legend segment selection filters the domain table
steps: Given the AI Citation Sources section with its stacked legend bar is visible
When the Editor clicks a source type segment in the legend bar
Then the domain table shows only rows matching the selected source type and the table is non-empty

testcases.title: GEO-66-TC007 — [SKIP] All domains modal opens with search
testcases.error: SKIPPED — "All domains" button presence on the category page not confirmed. Pattern already validated in GEO-74-TC006 on the overview dashboard. Re-enable once DOM inspection confirms the button on this page.

testcases.title: GEO-66-TC008 — [SKIP] Market filter recalculates perception topics and citation sources
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Market filter availability on category page not confirmed. Re-enable with dedicated before/after comparison or sandboxed test report.

testcases.title: GEO-66-TC009 — [SKIP] LLM filter recalculates both components
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Requires deselecting an LLM and comparing before/after state on both Perception Topics and Citation Sources. Re-enable with a dedicated recalculation test helper.

testcases.title: GEO-66-TC010 — [SKIP] Empty state messages are displayed
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Requires a category with zero perception responses and zero citation sources. Cannot be reproduced on current staging report. Re-enable with a dedicated empty-state test category or seeded dataset.

testcases.title: GEO-66-TC011 — [SKIP] Error state displayed with retry option
testcases.error: SKIPPED — Requires simulating an API failure for the perception topics or citation sources endpoint. Cannot be triggered reliably without network interception. Re-enable with a mock-server or network interception approach.

testcases.title: GEO-66-TC012 — Sources classification: every domain in the AI Citation Sources table matches its expected source type from the oracle (GEO-393 regression)
steps: Given: navigate to the category page and scroll to AI Citation Sources
When: the AI Citation Sources table is rendered with all rows (no source-type filter applied)
Then: every domain present in BOTH the table and the oracle has actualType === expectedType (oracle: sources-classification-oracle.json)
